faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Field Investigator post at Presidency University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Field Investigator position at Presidency University is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Sociology with a minimum of 55% marks. Additionally, good reading and writing skills in English and knowledge of computer applications like MS-Word and MS-Excel are necessary.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Field Investigator position announced by Presidency University in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Field Investigator post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Field Investigator recruitment at Presidency University is through email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Field Investigator post at Presidency University.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Investigator position at Presidency University will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator position at Presidency University is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Presidency University located?
faq.answer: Presidency University is located in Kolkata, West Bengal, with a pincode of 700073.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification is released by Presidency University in West Bengal. While the notification does not explicitly restrict applications based on state of residence, candidates should check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.
